prompt: Into the Splice project {project}, record the main display for about 3 seconds, pause the recording, then resume it with a marker named "Step 2", record about 3 more seconds and stop. It must stay one take. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: marker Step 2 at the resume
checks.expr: any(m['name'] == 'Step 2' and 2 <= seconds(m['at']) <= 4.5 for m in markers)
